pre_condition: data is a dict parsed from a JSON file.
post_condition: Returns True when data contains exactly the key "callees" whose value is an array, and every element of that array is a dict containing exactly the string-valued keys "name", "signature", "pre_condition", and "post_condition". Returns False in all other cases: data is not a dict, data has keys other than or missing "callees", the value of "callees" is not an array, any element of that array is not a dict, any element lacks any of the four required keys, or any key's value is not of type str.
